name: Slacker
tagline: Cuts Slack down to the handful of messages that actually need you

source.excerpt: Shared as a way to stop reading every channel and still never miss the message that mattered.

body:
## What it does

Aimed at revenue and enablement leads who live in a loud workspace. Three times a day it sweeps the channels and hands you a short list of only the threads genuinely waiting on your answer, each one already paired with a reply you can send as-is. Silence means nothing needs you. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @scottxmetcalf shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
